projects.description: Upload PDFs, hit Build Index, ask questions — get short answers with [Page X] citations. Says 'I don't know from the PDFs' when out of syllabus. No hallucinations, no extra gyaan.
highlights: Parent-child chunking (1000/300 chars, overlap 50)
Hybrid retrieval: FAISS + BM25 with RRF + cross-encoder rerank
LangGraph pipeline: rewrite → retrieve → answer → citation verify
60-query eval harness (50 normal + 10 adversarial) reporting Hit@5, MRR and NDCG
projects.tagline: Ask your PDFs, get answers with proof.
projects.title: Veritas AI

projects.description: Ask analytics questions in plain English, get safe SQL + results + charts. Only SELECT allowed — DROP/DELETE/UPDATE auto-blocked, org_id filter compulsory, LIMIT 200 auto-added, Redis cached.
highlights: Natural-language → SELECT-only SQL via Groq
SQL guardrail: sqlglot parse + PII block + org_id enforcement
LangGraph flow: make → check (+ retry scope)
FastAPI /query + /audit, Streamlit UI, Docker Postgres + Redis
projects.tagline: Natural language to safe SQL agent.
projects.title: QueryPilot

projects.description: ETL pipelines break at 2am on schema drift. DriftGuard detects drift, drafts fix SQL with Groq, tests on sandbox Postgres, asks human to approve, then applies with rollback.
highlights: LangGraph: detect → draft → test → approve → apply
Sandbox vs Prod Postgres (local Docker + live Neon)
POST /detect (suggest) + POST /approve (backup + apply + rollback)
28/30 golden breaks auto-fixed in sandbox, re-runs down 60% — live on Render + Streamlit
projects.title: DriftGuard AI

projects.description: Voice + text support copilot: retrieves from PDFs, help URLs and 5K past tickets, checks live orders, creates tickets, escalates to humans when confidence < 0.7.
highlights: Hybrid retrieval (Dense + BM25 + rerank) with source+page citations
LangGraph agent: intent → retriever → tool-router → responder
MCP tools: orders, policies, tickets + LiveKit voice (STT/VAD/TTS)
Redis semantic cache + Langfuse observability + eval-gated CI
projects.tagline: Voice + text support copilot on MCP.
projects.title: VoxServe

Groq LLM answers strictly from transcript
